description: Compare one XBRL concept across ALL reporting companies for a calendar period (SEC frames API), e.g. rank by revenue for CY2024, or compare specific companies. Period: CY2024 (annual duration), CY2024Q2 (quarter), CY2024Q4I (instant, required for balance-sheet items like Assets). Pass companies to filter to specific tickers/CIKs; otherwise returns the top `limit` by value.

companies.description: Tickers or CIKs to include (default: all)

name: compare_companies
title: Cross-company comparison (XBRL frames)
